name: Prospice: Anomalous Logistics
description:
About This Game

Beyond broken trails and untamed terrain lies a place where the world itself unravels - an island cursed by the corpses of ever rotting gods. Uncover the story of humankind's ancestry on your expedition for occult knowledge.

You are a driver, plotting river crossings and navigating bogs and rocky slopes to push exploration further and deeper. You are also a pathfinder, a witness, a courier of forgotten truths, and a trespasser in a place where remnants of humanity’s original sin still fester. You carry more than supplies: survival, knowledge, and perhaps the key to awakening something that should remain buried.

Features:

  • Survival Logistics - Plan routes, manage fuel, and complete deliveries across treacherous terrain.

  • Artifacts & Cargo - Keep outposts running and transport unique finds, each a fragment of humanity’s forgotten hunt for the divine prey.

  • On-Foot Exploration - Leave the safety of your truck to interact with your environment and uncover ancient secrets.

  • Hand-Crafted Open World - Explore a vast, uncharted land from its coastline to the heart of the island, warped by dreams of god-husks.

  • Upgrade for the Unknown - Upgrade and adapt your vehicle to survive deeper incursions into corrupted lands.

  • Document the Uncanny - Use specialized tools to identify, recover, and record artifacts born of godly decay.
short_desc: Haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain can take your life and every road bears the scars of the past.
